distanceSource: Inverse of the parallax 747.17 ± 0.61 mas that Kervella et al. (2017) adopt from Kervella et al. (2016)
radiusSource: Radius: Limb-darkened angular diameter 5.999 ± 0.025 mas measured with VLTI/PIONIER by Kervella et al.
